_notes: Tutoiement, as on the French site. Headings follow French gym/magazine usage: 'exécution', 'muscles travaillés', 'la bonne technique', 'Variantes', 'Exercices pectoraux' (no article, so any muscle fits). Checked toutelanutrition Wikifit, Decathlon Conseil Sport, Ma Salle de Sport, MuscleWiki/Fitwill FR (blocked, seen via search). Titles put {name} before ' : ' so no le/la/les agreement is needed. intro is label-style because 'exercice isolation' is wrong (it would need 'd'isolation'); it assumes {level}/{mechanic}/{primary} and {muscle} in m_title/m_h1 arrive lower-cased (lower_muscles); capitalised still reads fine as labels.
